spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise
spec.vuln_cue: says they can't afford this, they've got nothing left until payday

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Owen speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s Femi Pemberton. There’s a card payment I don’t recognise, and I’m really unhappy with you lot. It’s been a nightmare trying to sort things out.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve had such a frustrating time, Femi. I can see a payment of £186.40 to Northstar Travel on your account from yesterday. I’ll look into what’s happened.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s the one. I didn’t make it. And I can’t afford this—I’ve got nothing left until payday.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry, that’s a lot to be dealing with. I can’t say what the outcome will be, but I can raise the payment for investigation. We also have a Financial Support team who can talk through options, including extra time with payments.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I need someone to actually take responsibility for this. I’ve already had to explain it twice.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I’ll take ownership of getting this started, and I’m logging this as a complaint about your experience as well. The complaints team will review that separately.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Before I go further, can you confirm your full name, date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Femi Pemberton, 14 June 1988, and 27 Birch Lane, Leeds.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. That matches our records. I’ll submit the card payment for investigation and pass your request for support to the Financial Support team.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Someone will be in touch about it. I can’t give you a timescale for their response, but I’ll make sure the case is sent through today.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, but I don’t want to have to chase again.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll follow up myself by the end of tomorrow to confirm it’s been sent to the investigation team and that the Financial Support referral is in place. I can’t promise what they’ll decide, but I’ll make sure those steps happen.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s logged too, and the complaints team will review your concerns about the service. So, to summarise: I’m submitting the payment for investigation today, referring you to Financial Support, and I’ll follow up by the end of tomorrow. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that makes sense. Thanks for listening.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Femi. I’m sorry again you’ve been left dealing with this, and I’ll follow up as agreed.
